plugins.name: Herdr
plugins.description: Use herdr, the terminal workspace manager for coding agents, from Termix with touch, mouse and a native navigator.
plugins.author: Diego Rodriguez
features: Attach to herdr on any SSH host in one tap
Touch becomes mouse: tap to click, long-press to right-click, hold and drag to select or resize, swipe to scroll
A key bar with herdr's prefix key, Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt and arrows
A navigator with every workspace, tab, pane and agent state
A tappable map of the current tab's panes
Prompt an agent or type into a pane from a normal text box, so phone keyboards and dictation work
Split, zoom, close and create without remembering keybindings

gated.notes:
### Added

- A Herdr tab that attaches to herdr on a host inside Termix's SSH terminal
- Touch as mouse: tap to click, long press to right click, long press and drag to drag, swipe to scroll
- A key bar with herdr's prefix, Ctrl, Alt, Esc, Tab, arrows and herdr actions
- A navigator with workspaces, tabs, agents waiting, a map of the current tab's panes and a text box that sends to the focused pane
- Open in Herdr on host rows and in the SSH terminal's toolbar
- Host settings for the herdr binary and session, and user settings for touch, long press, prefix key and the key bar

plugins.name: Host Icons
plugins.description: Give each host in the Hosts list its own icon and color.
plugins.author: ZarenOFF
features: Pick an icon or a brand logo (Linux, Windows, Kubernetes and more) for each host
Set a default icon for a whole folder
Large icon left of the host, or small before or after the name, at the size you like
Automatic icons for hosts with a tag or a name you choose

versions.notes:
First release.

### Added

- An Icon and an Icon color field in the host editor, with a searchable picker of general icons and an Icons and Brands switch
- Brand logos to pick from: operating systems and Linux distributions, clouds, containers, databases, network gear and more, colored by the icon color like the other icons
- Icon and color defaults for a folder, a user or the whole server
- The icon in the Hosts list: large and left of the host, or small before or after the name, picked per user under Icon position, indenting only hosts that have an icon unless the user lines up all names
- Icon size, from 50% to 150%
- Change icon in the host context menu and in the command palette, where Use default hands the icon or the color back to the folder, user or server default
- Automatic icons: rules that give hosts an icon or a color by tag or by name, in a table you can reorder by dragging, with suggestions from your tags. A rule fills in what a host has not got, or with Priority on replaces the host's own icon
- Russian translation

plugins.name: Proxmox Power
plugins.description: Start Proxmox VMs and LXC containers on demand and shut them down after idle CPU use or a time limit.
plugins.author: jeakob
features: Start or gracefully stop a Proxmox VM or LXC container
Start a linked guest from its host action before connecting
Graceful shutdown after sustained idle CPU use or maximum uptime

versions.notes:
### Fixed

- The Proxmox host list in guest setup was empty. Hosts now appear when **Proxmox Power** is enabled in their host editor; the bundled Proxmox Integration switch is no longer required. Guest setup now says this under the host field.

### Changed

- Both shutdown rules can be 0, so a guest can be started and stopped without automatic shutdown.

### Changed

- Add screenshots and a usage guide to the docs.
- Move all interface text into `locales/en.json`, ready for translation.
- Document every API route with OpenAPI.
- Remove an unneeded import query from the shutdown policy module.

plugins.name: Remote VS Code
plugins.description: Seamlessly open a web-based VS Code workspace on any saved SSH host.
plugins.author: Tech-Innovators-Dev
features: Opens code-server on a host over the saved SSH connection
Nothing listens on the Termix server: the tunnel is an SSH channel
Per-host code-server path and default workspace

versions.notes:
### Changed

- The "code-server is not installed" screen links to the install guide instead of showing an install command.
